Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: An outlier is an observation that

Options: 
A. is the mode of the data set
B. is the mean of the data set
C. is seen more frequently than the other observations in the data set
D. is always larger than the other observations in the data set
E. is always smaller than the other observations in the data set
F. is seen less frequently than the other observations in the data set
G. is significantly different from the other observations in the data set
H. is an error in the data set
I. is the median of the data set
J. is exactly the same as the other observations in the data set

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.

    *   A. is the mode of the data set: Incorrect. Many datasets have modes; outliers can be anything.

    *   H. is an error in the data set: Incorrect. While outliers *can* be errors, they can also be valid rare events. Calling them *errors* is a conclusion, not the definition.
